traditional: 喺 A 望落去可以見到 B
jyutping: hai2 A mong6 lok6 heoi3 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 B

english.note: Use this construction when a place at a higher position gives a view down onto something.

examples.english: From the hilltop, you can overlook the whole harbour.
examples.traditional: 喺山頂望落去可以見到成個維港。
examples.jyutping: hai2 saan1 deng2 mong6 lok6 heoi3 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 seng4 go3 wai4 gong2
